title: After the Big Bridge
can_do: 在车里询问还要多久，并用一个可观察路标理解回答。
trigger: The child wants to know when the car ride to Grandma's house will end.
stretch_response: How much longer until we get there?
repair_response: I mean, how long until Grandma's house?
setting: Buckled into the car on a familiar trip.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: We are on the way to Grandma's house.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: How much longer until we get there?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: About ten minutes, after we cross the big bridge.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can you tell me when we reach the bridge?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: There it is. Now we have about five minutes.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Okay. I can look for Grandma's street now.

replay_cards.title: Two songs to home
replay_cards.setting: In the car after an outing
replay_cards.change: Dad answers with two familiar songs rather than minutes
replay_cards.challenge: Ask how much longer, listen for the song count, and notice when the second song ends

replay_cards.title: After the next stop
replay_cards.change: Mom explains they leave after the next stop
replay_cards.challenge: Ask about the wait, repeat the landmark, and get ready when it appears

parent_support: Give a short truthful estimate plus a landmark the child can notice.
The driver keeps attention on driving; the scene needs no turning or prop handling.
